en.eyebrow: The world's first Mercedes-Benz branded city
en.intro: Vision Iconic. An extraordinary address at Mercedes-Benz Places | Binghatti City, Dubai.
en.headline:
Some addresses follow the skyline.
This one defines it.
en.body: A sculptural silver spine. Terraces that flow into the sky. A new expression of the Mercedes-Benz design language, translated into a place to call home. Vision Iconic brings monumental architecture to Dubai's Nad Al Sheba district.
en.caption: Architecture in motion. A statement from every angle.
en.lifeBody: A double-height grand lobby, natural stone and brass accents set the tone. Beyond the entrance, discover spaces designed for wellbeing, connection and a slower kind of luxury.
en.resBody: From one-bedroom residences to expansive duplex homes. Explore the brochure's starting prices and request the current release, payment schedule and available views.
en.priceNote: Brochure starting prices; availability and final offers require developer confirmation. USD figures are those printed in the brochure, indicative only. Area and layout vary by unit.
en.investBody: An international hub for living, business and connectivity. Explore a property purchase with a developer payment plan, while keeping the full costs and your personal circumstances in view.
benefits: UAE personal income tax
The UAE does not levy personal income tax. Personal real estate investment income is generally excluded from UAE corporate tax, subject to the applicable conditions.
UAE tax on personal property gains
Gains from qualifying personal real estate investments are generally outside UAE corporate tax. Your country of tax residence may still tax income and gains.
Agency commission offer
A buyer-side zero agency commission offer must be confirmed in writing. Dubai Land Department fees, registration, service charges and other costs still apply.
Remote
Buy from abroad
Remote purchase can be arranged subject to the developer's process. A passport begins the file; identity checks, source-of-funds evidence and other documents may be required.
steps: Choose your residence
Review available units, the exact price, floor plan and developer terms.
Confirm your payment plan
Developer instalments can differ from a mortgage. Salary slips may not be required, but compliance checks and supporting documents can still apply.
Complete your purchase
Confirm the contract, secure payment instructions and registration process before transferring funds.
en.visaBody: Property investment may support an investor residence visa. Real estate Golden Visa applications generally require qualifying property investment of at least AED 2 million, plus the relevant authority's conditions. Eligibility and approval are never automatic.
en.countryBody: You can explore Dubai property from your home country and arrange a remote purchase where supported. Check local tax reporting, exchange costs and legal requirements before committing.
faq: What is Vision Iconic?
Vision Iconic is a residential and retail tower at Mercedes-Benz Places | Binghatti City in Nad Al Sheba 1, Dubai. The supplied brochure describes 67 residential floors and 1,426 apartments.
What are the starting prices in AED and USD?
The brochure lists one-bedroom residences from AED 2,250,000 and USD 612,245. Prices depend on the residence and release. Request a current written quotation before making a decision.
Can I buy remotely with only a passport?

Remote buying may be possible. A passport is a starting document, not a guarantee that no other documents will be needed. The developer, bank and authorities may require identity, address and source-of-funds checks.
Are salary slips required for the payment plan?

A developer payment plan is different from mortgage finance and may not require salary slips. The actual requirements and schedule must be confirmed with the developer; compliance documents may still be requested.
Is Dubai property completely tax-free?

The UAE does not levy personal income tax, and qualifying personal property investment income and gains are generally excluded from UAE corporate tax. Registration fees and other property costs apply. Your home country may impose additional taxes.
Does buying a residence guarantee a Golden Visa?

No. A qualifying property investment of at least AED 2 million can provide a route to a real estate Golden Visa, subject to official conditions and approval. Other property investor residence options have separate criteria.
Is agency commission really zero?
A zero buyer-side commission offer needs written confirmation from the agency. It does not remove government registration fees, developer charges, service charges or other purchase costs.
en.finalTitle:
YOUR NEXT CHAPTER.
STARTS WITH A VIEW.
en.finalBody: Request the current price list, available residences and developer payment plan.
en.footer: Discover Vision Iconic at Mercedes-Benz Places | Binghatti City. Branded residences in Nad Al Sheba 1, Dubai, United Arab Emirates.
en.legal: Project information and architectural renders are sourced from the supplied brochure and may change. This website is an enquiry presentation, not the official Mercedes-Benz or Binghatti website. Returns, tax treatment and residence visas are not guaranteed.
en.privacyText: Enquiries are submitted through Tally. Review the information requested and the receiving party before submitting. Tally privacy information: https://tally.so/help/privacy-policy. This site does not add advertising trackers or store your enquiry locally.

faq: Qu'est-ce que Vision Iconic ?
Une tour résidentielle et commerciale de Mercedes-Benz Places | Binghatti City, à Nad Al Sheba 1, Dubaï. La brochure annonce 67 étages résidentiels et 1 426 appartements.
Quels sont les prix en AED et USD ?
La brochure indique un départ à 2 250 000 AED et 612 245 USD pour une chambre. Demandez un devis écrit actualisé selon le lot et sa disponibilité.
Peut-on acheter à distance avec un passeport uniquement ?

L'achat à distance peut être possible. Le passeport est un document de départ, pas une garantie d'absence d'autres justificatifs. Le promoteur, la banque et les autorités peuvent demander des contrôles d'identité, d'adresse et d'origine des fonds.
Faut-il des fiches de paie ?
Un plan de paiement promoteur est différent d'un prêt bancaire et peut ne pas nécessiter de fiches de paie. Les conditions exactes et justificatifs de conformité doivent être confirmés.
L'investissement est-il totalement exonéré d'impôts ?

Les EAU n'appliquent pas d'impôt sur le revenu personnel ; les investissements immobiliers personnels admissibles sont généralement exclus de l'impôt sur les sociétés. Des frais immobiliers restent dus et votre résidence fiscale française peut entraîner des obligations fiscales.
L'achat garantit-il le Golden Visa ?

Non. Un investissement immobilier admissible d'au moins 2 millions AED peut ouvrir une voie vers le Golden Visa, sous conditions officielles et approbation. Les autres visas investisseur ont leurs propres critères.
La commission d'agence est-elle de 0 % ?
L'offre doit être confirmée par écrit. Elle ne supprime pas les frais d'enregistrement, du promoteur, les charges ou les autres coûts d'acquisition.

Fiscalidad local de plusvalías personales

benefits: Persoonlijke inkomstenbelasting in de VAE
De VAE heffen geen persoonlijke inkomstenbelasting. Persoonlijke vastgoedbeleggingsinkomsten vallen doorgaans buiten de vennootschapsbelasting, onder voorwaarden.
Lokale belasting op persoonlijke vastgoedwinst
Toegestane persoonlijke vastgoedwinsten vallen doorgaans buiten de vennootschapsbelasting in de VAE. Je fiscale woonland kan wel belasting heffen.
Aanbod zonder makelaarscommissie

Op afstand
Kopen vanuit Nederland

faq: Wat is Vision Iconic?
Een woon- en winkeltoren in Mercedes-Benz Places | Binghatti City, Nad Al Sheba 1, Dubai. De brochure noemt 67 woonverdiepingen en 1.426 appartementen.
Wat zijn de prijzen in AED en USD?
De brochure noemt één slaapkamer vanaf AED 2.250.000 en USD 612.245. Vraag altijd een actuele schriftelijke offerte voor de gekozen woning.
Kan ik op afstand kopen met alleen een paspoort?
Aankoop op afstand kan mogelijk zijn. Een paspoort is het startdocument; ontwikkelaar, bank en autoriteiten kunnen ook identiteit, adres en herkomst van middelen controleren.
Zijn loonstroken nodig?
Een ontwikkelaarsplan verschilt van een hypotheek en kan zonder loonstroken mogelijk zijn. Laat de voorwaarden en vereiste documenten bevestigen.
Is vastgoed volledig belastingvrij?

De VAE heffen geen persoonlijke inkomstenbelasting. Toegestane persoonlijke vastgoedinkomsten en winsten vallen doorgaans buiten de vennootschapsbelasting. Vastgoedkosten blijven gelden en je Nederlandse fiscale woonplaats kan belastingverplichtingen opleveren.
Garandeert een aankoop een Golden Visa?
Nee. Een toegestane vastgoedinvestering van minimaal AED 2 miljoen kan toegang bieden tot een aanvraag, onder officiële voorwaarden en goedkeuring. Andere investeerdersvisa hebben eigen criteria.
Is de makelaarscommissie echt 0%?
Laat dit schriftelijk bevestigen. Registratiekosten, ontwikkelaarskosten, servicekosten en overige kosten blijven gelden.

Kann ich aus der Ferne nur mit einem Reisepass kaufen?
Fernkauf kann möglich sein. Der Reisepass ist ein erstes Dokument; Bauträger, Bank und Behörden können Identität, Adresse und Mittelherkunft prüfen.
Benötige ich Gehaltsabrechnungen?
Ein Bauträger-Zahlungsplan kann ohne Gehaltsabrechnungen möglich sein und unterscheidet sich von einer Hypothek. Bedingungen und Unterlagen müssen bestätigt werden.
Sind Immobilien vollständig steuerfrei?

Die VAE erheben keine persönliche Einkommensteuer. Qualifizierte persönliche Immobilienerträge und Gewinne sind grundsätzlich von der Körperschaftsteuer ausgeschlossen. Immobilienkosten bleiben bestehen; der deutsche steuerliche Wohnsitz kann weitere Pflichten begründen.
Garantiert der Kauf ein Golden Visa?

Nein. Eine qualifizierte Immobilieninvestition ab AED 2 Millionen kann eine Antragsmöglichkeit eröffnen, vorbehaltlich offizieller Bedingungen und Genehmigung. Andere Investorenvisa haben eigene Kriterien.
Ist die Maklerprovision wirklich 0 %?
Das Angebot ist schriftlich zu bestätigen. Registrierungs-, Bauträger- und Servicegebühren sowie weitere Kosten entfallen dadurch nicht.

benefits: Imposto sobre rendimento pessoal nos EAU
Os EAU não cobram imposto sobre o rendimento pessoal. Rendimentos de investimentos imobiliários pessoais estão geralmente excluídos do imposto sobre sociedades, sob condições.
Tributação local de mais-valias pessoais
Mais-valias de investimentos imobiliários pessoais elegíveis estão geralmente fora do imposto sobre sociedades nos EAU. O seu país de residência fiscal pode tributá-las.
Oferta sem comissão de agência
A ausência de comissão ao comprador deve ser confirmada por escrito. Mantêm-se taxas do Dubai Land Department, registo, serviços e outros custos.
À distância
Comprar a partir de Portugal
A compra remota depende do processo do promotor. O passaporte inicia o processo; podem ser exigidos comprovativos de identidade, origem dos fundos e outros documentos.

steps: Escolha a residência

faq: O que é Vision Iconic?
Uma torre residencial e comercial em Mercedes-Benz Places | Binghatti City, Nad Al Sheba 1, Dubai. A brochura apresenta 67 pisos residenciais e 1.426 apartamentos.
Quais são os preços em AED e USD?
A brochura indica um quarto desde 2.250.000 AED e 612.245 USD. Solicite uma proposta escrita atualizada para a unidade pretendida.
Posso comprar à distância apenas com passaporte?
A compra remota pode ser possível. O passaporte é um documento inicial; promotor, banco e autoridades podem exigir verificações de identidade, morada e origem de fundos.
Preciso de recibos de vencimento?
Um plano do promotor difere de um crédito hipotecário e pode dispensar recibos de vencimento. Confirme as condições e os documentos de conformidade exigidos.
O investimento está totalmente isento de impostos?

Os EAU não cobram imposto sobre rendimento pessoal e investimentos imobiliários pessoais elegíveis estão geralmente excluídos do imposto sobre sociedades. Existem custos imobiliários e a residência fiscal portuguesa pode gerar impostos e obrigações declarativas.
A compra garante o Golden Visa?
Não. Um investimento imobiliário elegível de pelo menos 2 milhões AED pode permitir uma candidatura, sujeita a condições oficiais e aprovação. Outros vistos de investidor têm critérios próprios.
A comissão é mesmo 0%?
A oferta deve ser confirmada por escrito. Não elimina taxas de registo, custos do promotor, encargos de serviços ou outros custos.
